limitations: Metrics measure acceleration error only, on this one force configuration; they do not show that the model generalises to other physical environments.
The model only sees (x, y, vx, vy) and was trained on a limited state range; states far outside that range are extrapolation.
The evaluation force differs from the force the checkpoint was trained on (or the checkpoint does not record it): this measures out-of-distribution behaviour.
Generated states come from random initial conditions; the seed is checked against all recorded train/validation/test split seeds.
